content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DPSRU?
faq.answer: The last date for Professor of Practice Nomination is 24 August 2026. However, the walk-in interviews for various posts are scheduled from 17 August 2026 to 22 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by DPSRU?
faq.answer: Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University (DPSRU) has released a total of 39 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor and other related positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The general qualification is a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject, along with NET/Ph.D. as per UGC norms. Specific qualifications vary for certain specialized posts like Ayurvedic Pharmacy and Nursing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per GNCTD norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 89435 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DPSRU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview at the specified venue with all required original documents and self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DPSRU recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor posts will involve a presentation followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for DPSRU recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for DPSRU recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be held at the DPSRU office in New Delhi. The specific address is Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University, Sector-3, Pushp Vihar, New Delhi - 110017.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.
